name: bus-stop-accessibility-public
label: Bus Stop Accessibility (Public)
author: Metehan Zorluoglu
description: Public/publication version. Southern Nevada: bus stop count only (0 vs 1+ stops, no amenity or frequency data). Washoe: full shelter and frequency scoring. Draws a project-area polygon and scores PST Question 10 (bus stop shelter and 20-minute frequency coverage) for bus stops inside it.
